title: Analyzing single cell transcriptome data from severe COVID-19 patients
author: Nassir, Tambi, et al.

steps.title: Prepare computational environment
steps.instruction: Ensure a Linux server (AMD EPYC 7402 24‑core, 132 GB RAM) or PC (iMac 4.3 GHz Intel i7, 16 GB RAM) with at least 16 GB RAM and ~30 GB free storage; install R 4.0.2 and required bioinformatics tools.

steps.title: Install required R packages
steps.instruction: Install CRAN packages: Seurat, SingleCellExperiment, scran, sceasy, reticulate, readxl, SeuratData, SeuratDisk, ggplot2, glue; load them with library() calls.

steps.title: Load expression matrix and metadata
steps.instruction: Read the HCA expression matrix and metadata (e.g., meta_cell_types_merged.tsv) with read.csv or read_excel, then create a SingleCellExperiment (SCE) object.

steps.title: Convert to h5ad format
steps.instruction: Use sceasy to convert the SCE object to an h5ad file for downstream Scanpy analysis.

steps.title: Check cell‑type name consistency
steps.instruction: Manually verify that cell‑type names are identical across all sources (e.g., "Brush cell" vs "Brush cells"); rename duplicates to avoid redundant clusters.

steps.title: Compile unique marker gene database
steps.instruction: Collect marker genes from literature (heat‑maps, dot‑plots, tables, databases), merge lists, and retain only unique genes per cell type, removing any duplicates intra‑ or inter‑cell type.

steps.title: Assign cell‑type identities
steps.instruction: For each cell‑type gene set, extract normalized expression across all clusters, compute median expression per cluster, plot boxplots, compare medians to the 99th percentile (q99) of all genes, and assign the cell type to the cluster with the highest median above q99.

substeps.instruction: Load marker database (cell_type_db1.xls) with read_excel.
Loop over each cell‑type (i = 1 to len) to concatenate gene symbols.
For each cell‑type, fetch expression (FetchData) for cells in a given cluster (e.g., severe$seurat_clusters == 10).
Calculate median of expression values; store in vector t.
Rank medians (order decreasing) and report the top cell‑type per cluster.
If desired, generate boxplot with ggplot (geom_boxplot + geom_point).
Assign identity based on highest normalized median expression.

steps.title: Prepare comorbid gene list
steps.instruction: Gather COVID‑19‑associated genes: cytokine/receptor genes (Immunology Database), monogenic infection genes (Casanova 2015), syndromic genes (SFARI), GWAS genes with p < 1e‑7, lung channelopathy genes, and DEGs from BALF (Zhou 2020). Save as a script (comorbidexpression.R).

substeps.instruction: Copy the script from https://github.com/MBRULab/2021_Nassir-etal/blob/main/comorbidexpression.R into a new R‑script.
Run the script in RStudio (press RUN) or via terminal (R < comorbidexpression.R).
The script outputs normalized median expression boxplots per cluster.

steps.title: Identify comorbid‑enriched cluster
steps.instruction: Mark clusters whose normalized median expression of the comorbid gene set exceeds the 99th percentile of the dataset; select the cluster with the greatest number of up‑regulated comorbid conditions (e.g., severe cluster 11).

steps.title: Downstream DEG analysis
steps.instruction: Using Seurat object of the selected cluster, run FindAllMarkers with test.use = "wilcox" (also t‑test if desired), select genes with highest probability across tests, rank by log‑fold change, and plot the top 20 with FeaturePlot and DotPlot to find markers uniquely up‑regulated in the severe cluster (e.g., FCGR3B).

substeps.instruction: FindAllMarkers(seu_object, test.use = "wilcox")
Filter for adjusted p‑value < 0.05 and logFC > 0.
Sort by logFC descending; take top 20 genes.
Generate FeaturePlot and DotPlot for these genes.
Choose genes with strong expression in cluster 11 and negligible expression elsewhere.

steps.title: Pathway enrichment analysis
steps.instruction: Run geneoverlap.R (GitHub link) with the DEG list from severe cluster 11 to query KEGG and GO; obtain CSV with pathway ID, name, p‑value, odds ratio; import into Cytoscape, install Enrichment Map and AutoAnnotate apps, and create an enrichment map using a FDR cutoff of 5 genes (adjustable on line 26).

substeps.instruction: Download Cytoscape from https://cytoscape.org/download.html.
In Cytoscape, open App Manager → install Enrichment Map and AutoAnnotate.
File → Import → Network → Generic/gProfiler; load the CSV files.
Set FDR cut‑off = 5 (minimum genes per pathway).

steps.title: In silico validation
steps.instruction: Execute validation scripts (validation_BALF_SC.R, validation_nasph.R, validation_pbmc.R) to compare FCGR3B expression between control and patient datasets and compute significance with t‑tests.

substeps.instruction: Copy each script from https://github.com/MBRULab/2021_Nassir-etal into RStudio or run via terminal (R < script.R).
Observe console output for expression plots and p‑values.

steps.title: Clinical nasopharyngeal RNA analysis
steps.instruction: Collect nasopharyngeal swabs in BD Universal Transport Media (UTM) 3 mL kit (Cat. No. 220531); extract viral RNA for SARS‑CoV‑2 RT‑qPCR (QIAamp Viral RNA Mini or EZ1 DSP Virus Kit); extract human RNA with RNeasy 96 QIAcube HT Kit; centrifuge 1,800 g 3 min, remove 1,650 µL supernatant, resuspend pellet in remaining 350 µL UTM and transfer to S Block; quantify RNA with NanoDrop 8000; reverse‑transcribe 10 µL master mix (0.8 µL 125× dNTP, 2 µL 10× RT Random Primers, 1 µL RNase inhibitor, 2 µL 10× RT Buffer, 3.2 µL nuclease‑free water) + 10 µL RNA; thermocycler: 25 °C 10 min, 37 °C 120 min, 85 °C 5 min, 44 °C hold; qPCR master mix (5 µL 2× TaqMan Fast Advanced, 0.5 µL 20× TaqMan probe, 3 µL water) + 1 µL cDNA; run 50 °C 2 min, 95 °C 5 min, 95 °C 1 s, 60 °C 20 s for 40 cycles; include no‑template control; analyze Ct values using 2⁻ΔΔCT (ΔCT = target – GAPDH; ΔΔCT = ΔCT_patient – ΔCT_control).

substeps.instruction: Critical: avoid RNase contamination throughout RNA work.
Critical: include no‑template control in qPCR.

steps.title: Spike‑protein stimulation of lung cells
steps.instruction: Culture Normal Human Primary Bronchial Epithelial (NHBE) cells from non‑obese and obese donors in BEGM + 1 % antibiotic/antimycotic on 12‑well plates coated with Type I rat tail collagen; grow to 90 % confluence, starve overnight in BEBM + 1 % antibiotic/antimycotic; stimulate with 1 µg/mL SARS‑CoV‑2 spike protein (S1+S2) for 3 h; collect media, centrifuge 5,000 g 5 min, aliquot supernatant and freeze at –80 °C.

steps.title: Monocyte isolation and treatment
steps.instruction: Isolate PBMCs from 40 mL blood using SepMate‑50 tubes; resuspend in RPMI 1640 + 1 % Pen/Strep, Glutamax, 10 % FBS; count monocytes and seed 1 × 10⁵ per well in a 48‑well plate; incubate 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for 3 h, wash twice with PBS, add RPMI + 0.5 % FBS and incubate 16 h; thaw NHBE conditioned media, add 100 µL to monocytes and incubate 24 h; extract total RNA with RiboZol (phenol‑chloroform); DNase‑treat 500 ng RNA with AccuRT kit (2 µL reaction mix + water to 6 µL, 5 min, add 2 µL stopper, total 10 µL); reverse‑transcribe with 5× All‑In‑One RT master mix (4 µL mix + 6 µL water, total 20 µL) using PCR steps: 25 °C 10 min, 42 °C 15 min, 85 °C 5 min, 44 °C hold; perform qPCR for FCGR3B and GAPDH with EvaGreen master mix (5 µL 2× EvaGreen, 0.5 µL primers, 2.4 µL water, total 10 µL) on a Bio‑Rad CFX96: 95 °C 20 s, 95 °C 3 s, 60 °C 30 s for 40 cycles, hold 4 °C; calculate ΔCT (target – GAPDH) and use ΔCT method for expression quantification.
